feeds.title: MNWeedEvents Blog
feeds.description: This blog covers local Minnesota cannabis events and other weed goodies. MNWeedEvents serves as a trusted source of cannabis sesh weed-related events, educational courses, and cannabis industry jobs in Minnesota, covering all towns and cities such as Anoka, Duluth, Fairmont, North Branch, Mankato, Minneapolis, Rochester, St Paul, and Stillwater.
